MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 14

2. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 121
   C. 11
   D. 122

3. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

4. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 18

6. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 25

7. Solve for x: x + 8 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 8
   C. 19
   D. 11

8. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 9

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 144

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 17

11. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 12
   C. 13
   D. 7

12. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 8
   D. 17

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
